claims.head: The Lightning will send their checkers at Scheifele
claims.call: The Lightning’s L3 (Mikheyev, Girgensons and Holmberg) spends at least 61% of its 5-on-5 time against the Jets’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Lightning keep sending Mikheyev’s line (Mikheyev, Girgensons and Holmberg) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Jon Cooper has been using this group as a checking line on the other team’s top line. Tonight the Jets’ first line is Connor, Scheifele and Perfetti.
claims.nums: At home: 61% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against first lines, about 33% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Jon Cooper likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Jets’ first line.
claims.cite: Matchups · Tampa Bay home games this season · 5 games, 49 minutes for this group at 5-on-5

chips.tip: Tampa Bay’s L3 (Mikheyev, Girgensons and Holmberg) at home: 61% of its 5-on-5 time against opponents’ first lines. Matchups, Tampa Bay home games this season, 5 games, 49 minutes for this group at 5-on-5.
With no line matching, this group would face first lines about 33% of the time, about as often as those lines are on the ice.

check.measure: share of Tampa Bay L3's 5-on-5 time against Winnipeg L1
check.rule: held if the share is at or above the home habit; partly if above the no-matching level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Skinner gets another crack at the Lightning
claims.body: Skinner has been shaky against the Lightning since 2023-24, well below his usual. But three seasons of data say a goalie’s record against one team tells us nothing about the next meeting, so don’t be surprised if he looks like himself tonight.
claims.nums: 5 starts against Tampa Bay: .852 save percentage · .900 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Skinner’s record against the Lightning.
claims.call: If Skinner starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .900 than to his .852 against the Lightning.
claims.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 5 against Tampa Bay, 4,214 shots against everyone else

chips.tip: Skinner: .852 save percentage in 5 starts against Tampa Bay since 2023-24.
Skinner: .900 save percentage against everyone else since 2023-24, on 4,214 shots.

check.rule: held if he starts and his save percentage is closer to his usual than to his record against this team; can't judge if he doesn't start

claims.head: Patience vs. Spray-and-pray
claims.body: The Lightning wait for good looks, but the Jets settle for hopeful ones. Tampa Bay is one of the league’s best for shot quality, and Winnipeg is one of the worst. The more dangerous chances should be the Lightning’s.

faceoff.text: Anthony Cirelli is sent out to take power-play faceoffs, then changes. He has taken 54% of the team’s power-play draws but stays on for about 24 seconds at a time, against 73 for the regulars, and is most often replaced by Brandon Hagel (17 of 24 changes).
